spec.description: Average LLM generation latency for allowed queries (ms)
spec.title: Avg Generation Time

spec.expr: avg(avg_over_time({job="clinical-ai-gateway"} | json | event_type="query" | decision="allowed" | unwrap completion_tokens [1h]) / (avg_over_time({job="clinical-ai-gateway"} | json | event_type="query" | decision="allowed" | unwrap generation_time_ms [1h]) / 1000))

spec.description: Completion tokens divided by generation time
spec.title: Avg Tokens per Second

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {job="clinical-ai-gateway"} | json | event_type="query" | decision="allowed" | unwrap latency_ms [5m])
quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="clinical-ai-gateway"} | json | event_type="query" | decision="allowed" | unwrap latency_ms [5m])
quantile_over_time(0.99, {job="clinical-ai-gateway"} | json | event_type="query" | decision="allowed" | unwrap latency_ms [5m])

spec.description: End-to-end query latency for allowed requests
spec.title: Query Latency Percentiles

spec.expr: avg by (query_category) (avg_over_time({job="clinical-ai-gateway"} | json | event_type="query" | decision="allowed" | unwrap latency_ms [1h]))
